data.description:
## What
Create tests/scripts/test-check-recipe-engines.sh defining expected behavior of the engine presence and version validation helper.

## Why
TDD RED phase: the engine check script is the independently testable unit. Sprint SKILL.md pre-flight step is instruction-only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- test-check-recipe-engines.sh exists and is executable
- Tests verify using stub task list (fixture JSON or env-injected paths):
  (a) task list with recipe:add-parameter (rope) → checks rope presence; if rope missing → outputs MISSING_ENGINE: rope minimum:1.7.0; (b) task list with no recipe: tasks → outputs NO_RECIPE_TASKS and exits 0 (no-op path); (c) rope present but version < min_version from registry → outputs OUTDATED_ENGINE: rope found:1.5.0 minimum:1.7.0; (d) all engines present and up-to-date → outputs ENGINES_OK and exits 0; (e) outputs MISSING_ENGINES_LIST=<engine1,engine2> env-var-style line so S5 fallback can consume it
- RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH and TASK_LIST_FILE env vars injectable for test isolation
- All tests FAIL before Task 2 is complete

## File Impact
- CREATE: tests/scripts/test-check-recipe-engines.sh

## Testing Mode
RED — write failing tests first

## Dependencies
None
